WHAT: KIE.ai proxies Veo 3.1 and Kling 3.0 under one API key

VEO:
  POST https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/veo/generate
  Body: { prompt, imageUrls: [url], model: 'veo3'/'veo3_fast', aspect_ratio: '9:16' }
  Poll: GET https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/veo/record-info?taskId=
  Response: { data: { successFlag: 0|1|2|3, resultUrls: ['https://...'] } }
  NOTE: resultUrls is already an ARRAY, NOT a JSON string (docs are wrong)

KLING:
  POST https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/createTask
  Body: { model: 'kling-3.0/video', input: { prompt, image_urls: [url], sound: true, duration: '10', aspect_ratio: '9:16', mode: 'pro', multi_shots: false, multi_prompt: [...] } }
  Poll: GET https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/recordInfo?taskId=
  NOTE: camelCase 'recordInfo', NOT 'record-info'

FILE UPLOAD (required before Kling — needs public URL):
  POST https://kieai.redpandaai.co/api/file-base64-upload
  Body: { base64Data: 'data:image/png;base64,...', uploadPath: 'images', fileName: 'avatar.png' }
  Response: { data: { downloadUrl: 'https://...' } }
  Expires in 3 days

GOTCHA: Kling does NOT accept data URIs or raw base64 for image_urls — must use public URL. Upload first.
